# Pakistan Info Hub (pakistaninfohub.com)

> Pakistan Info Hub is an independent, verified civic and public services information directory for Pakistan. It provides accurate, up-to-date guides, official fee schedules, required document checklists, portal links, helpline numbers, and verification procedures for citizens in Pakistan and overseas Pakistanis.

## Core Service Directories Covered

- NADRA Services: https://pakistaninfohub.com/nadra
  - CNIC Application & Renewal Guide: https://pakistaninfohub.com/nadra/cnic-kaise-banaye
  - NADRA Fee Schedule 2026: https://pakistaninfohub.com/nadra/nadra-card-fee
  - CNIC Application Tracking: https://pakistaninfohub.com/nadra/tracking-id
  - NICOP for Overseas Pakistanis: https://pakistaninfohub.com/nadra/nicop-apply-online

## Key Official Helplines in Pakistan

- NADRA Helpline: 1777 (Mobile) | +92-51-111-786-100 (Landline)
- BISP 8171 Toll-Free Helpline: 0800-26477
- Passport DGIP Helpline: 051-111-344-777
- Utility Bills Complaint Helpline: 118
- Punjab Safe Cities Authority (E-Challan): 15 / 042-111-15-15-15
